TRAFFIC SAFETY COMMITTEE
  MEETING AGENDA
  THURSDAY MARCH 21, 2024 9:30 AM
  SAN DIMAS COUNCIL CHAMBER CONFERENCE ROOM
  245 EAST BONITA AVENUE

PLEASE NOTE: Traffic Safety Committee is an Advisory Committee which is open to the public. In order to conduct the
meeting effectively and fairly, participants will be given an opportunity to discuss their concerns within a 3-minute time
allotment. This timing has been instituted to ensure everyone wishing to speak has the same opportunity. We appreciate
your understanding and cooperation with this policy.

If you have any additional questions, please contact staff at (909) 394-6240 or email at publicworks@sandimasca.gov.

  INTRODUCTIONS

  DISCUSSION ITEMS

03-24-01 Eaton Road Red Curb Request
Request by Resident, to review and consider installation of red curb on a portion of Eaton Road in front of 1141.

03-24-02 One and All Church 1404 W Covina Blvd
Request by Resident, to review and consider placing new signs with code allowing the sheriff to issue parking citations.
Issue parking passes for each resident so they can have guests visit during these service times.

03-24-03 BUSD Removal of Red Curb at Ekstrand Elementary
Request by BUSD, to review and consider the red zones in front of the school on Walnut Avenue to be changed to “drop off
only” zones. To review and consider the removal of some the red zones across the street creating more parking for staff
and parents.

03-24-04 E Gladstone and N San Dimas Cyn Rd
Request by Resident, review and consider increasing stop sign visibility at E Gladstone and N San Dimas Cyn Rd.

03-24-05 N Delancey Avenue
Request by Resident, review and consider the installation of speed humps or something to reduce traffic speed along
Delancey from Payson to Juanita

03-24-06 Oakway Ave and Ghent Ave
Request by Resident, review and consider stop signs to be installed at Oakway Ave and Ghent Ave.

03-24-07 Review High Incidence Intersection Report
Request by Staff, review High Incidence Intersection Report.

03-24-08 1735 Avenida Entrada Red Curb
Request by Resident, review and install red curb to create better stop sign visibility at Avenida Entrada and Calle Serra

03-24-09 BUSD Allen Ave and Monte Vista Crossing
Request by Resident, review and consider adding a crosswalk and/or a Stop sign at Allen Ave and Monte Vista Ave near
Chaparral High School

OFF AGENDA ITEMS:
NONE

  CONTINUED ITEMS
 NONE
  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

  ADJOURNMENT

  Notice Regarding Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need assistance
  to participate in a city meeting, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (909) 394-6216. Early notification
  before the meeting you wish to attend will make it possible for the City to make reasonable arrangements to
  ensure accessibility to this meeting [28 CFR 35.102-35.104 ADA Title II].
Copies of documents distributed for the meeting are available in alternative formats upon request. Any writings or
documents provided to the Traffic Safety Committee regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for
public review Monday through Thursday 7:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. and on Fridays from 7:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. at the Public
Works Department. In addition, most documents are posted on the City’s website at www.sandimasca.gov.

Posting Statement: I declare under penalty of perjury that on March 14, 2024, I posted a true and correct copy of this
agenda on the bulletin board in the Civic Center Plaza of City Hall at 245 E. Bonita Ave., and on the City’s
website www.sandimasca.gov/agendas-minutes/ as required by law.

  Genevieve Amaro
March 21, 2024  Genevieve Amaro, Management Aide
